# Start, check, done, wait, handoff and sessions, outside git.
$ wk init --store repo --preset general
$ wk add "Write the intro"
$ wk add "Draft chapter one"
$ wk add "Draft chapter two" --when "after:4y"
$ wk add "Proofread everything" --when someday
$ wk ls
$ wk brief
$ wk check
$ wk start 4yrm
$ wk start 4yrm
$ wk check --checked "spellcheck clean" --test "Read it aloud\nCheck the tone"
$ wk done 4yrm
$ wk handoff "Intro drafted.\nNext: chapter one."
$ wk handoff "1\n2\n3\n4\n5\n6"
$ wk brief
$ wk next
$ wk ls
$ wk wait aes8 "an editor"
$ wk wait --clear aes8
tree
$ wk start aes8
$ wk jot "Chapter two needs a map\nmaybe two"
$ wk start xcma
$ wk wait aes8 "the editor"
$ wk start xcma
$ wk check --fresh --handoff "Proofing.\nNext: done."
$ wk done xcma
$ wk done xcma
$ wk done yebg --force
$ wk ls --all
$ wk done nope
$ wk show yebg
now 2026-11-10T11:30:00.000Z
$ wk board --out board.html
tree
